0022600141.text: Utah (1-2, 1-1 at home, on a one-game losing streak) hosts San Antonio (1-2, 0-2 at home, on a one-game winning streak) in the Jazz's fifth game of the 2026-27 season, with Utah 5th in the Northwest and 12th in the West and San Antonio 4th in the Southwest and 11th in the West, both two games back. Utah is missing Jaxson Hayes (shoulder soreness), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions; San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Jazz lost 1-2 to the Spurs in the 2025-26 season series, including a 126-109 loss in Salt Lake City on January 22, 2026.
